newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cemex says to initiate share buyback. [CORRECTED 22:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Cemex says to initiate share buyback. [CORRECTED 22:35 GMT]

text.p: Cement producer Cemex SA said on Thursday it had approved the creation of a nine-billion-pesos reserve for its share buyback program at its annual meeting. (Corrects to show the reserve had been approved)
"The reserve for the obtaining of the shares issued by the company will be 9.0 billion pesos," said Lorenzo Zambrano, president and director-general of the company.

Zambrano said the buyback will last for one year and use a maximum of 1.6 billion of the reserves. It will start this June with the objective of buying back up to 2.5 percent of the total of the outstanding shares. (Corrects to show that up to 1.6 billion pesos worth of the reserve would be used)
At the end of 1996, the company had 1.303 billion oustanding shares.
